subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A wetland near the city had been drained years ago for construction, but the land often flooded after…”?
options: The project made students notice sound as part of city life.
A city discovered part of an ancient wall during subway construction.
The city cleaned part of it and opened a walking path beside the water.
The city decided to restore part of it.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The project made students notice sound as part of city life.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A city discovered part of an ancient wall during subway construction.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The city cleaned part of it and opened a walking path beside the water.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The city decided to restore part of it.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The city decided to restore part of it.」，答案為「The city decided to restore part of it.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The city decided to restore part of it.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
